question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses** the lasting impression and effect that a work of art can have on our senses.**
 
• **"Impact" **is the **most appropriate word as it conveys the powerful influence and strong effect that the work of art leaves on us.**
 
• Other options like "**affect", "result", and "blow"** do not appropriately convey the intended meaning of a significant and lasting influence.
 
• The correct word to be placed in fill in the blank no. 5 is** '****Impact.'**
 
• Therefore the correct statement from he given passage is **"he reminds us that it is important to visit museums in our country to experience the *impact *__that a work of art leaves on our senses, to find among all the riches one particular vision of beauty that speaks to us alone..."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Affect" **means to have an influence on or cause a change in, which is similar but less appropriate compared to "impact" in this context.
 
• **"Result"** means the outcome of an action, which does not fit as well in the context of the description of art's effect on our senses.
 
• **"Blow"** means a sudden shock or disappointment, which is not suitable in this context.
